description: Complete inventory of user-configurable settings for Gaimer Desktop. Use as binding contract for settings UI design.

options.label: OpenAI Realtime
options.description: gpt-realtime-1.5 — best instruction following, semantic VAD

settings.label: Allow Unsolicited Agent Speech
settings.description: When enabled, the agent can speak without being asked — alerts, commentary, and reminders.

children.label: Danger Alerts
children.description: Urgent warnings: mate threats, blunders, traps

children.label: Tool Results
children.description: Speak results from engine analysis, replay search, etc.

children.label: Deferred Reminders
children.description: Deliver results from earlier questions when you're free

categories.name: API Keys
categories.description: Keys are stored in platform-secure storage (Keychain on macOS).

settings.label: OpenAI API Key
settings.description: Required for OpenAI Realtime voice and GPT-4o chat

settings.label: Gemini API Key
settings.description: Required for Gemini Live voice and video analysis

settings.label: OpenRouter API Key
settings.description: Required for brain analysis (vision model)

settings.label: Inference Mode
settings.description: Controls whether AI runs in the cloud, locally, or local-first with cloud fallback.

options.label: Cloud Only
options.description: All AI runs in the cloud (recommended)

options.label: Local Only
options.description: All AI runs locally via Ollama (experimental)

options.label: Local First
options.description: Prefer local, fall back to cloud

settings.label: Ollama Server URL
settings.description: Local inference server endpoint

settings.label: Local Brain Model
settings.description: Ollama model name for local vision analysis

settings.label: Vision Model
settings.description: Model used for screen capture analysis (OpenRouter)
settings.note: Guard: NEVER change without explicit user approval (feedback_brain_model_guard.md)

settings.label: Video Analysis Model (Flash)
settings.description: Gemini model for replay video analysis

settings.label: Video Analysis Model (Pro)
settings.description: Gemini model for deep replay analysis fallback

categories.name: Agent Selection
categories.description: Agent is selected from the agent selection screen, not settings. These are read-only reference values.

options.label: Leroy
options.description: Cocky chess genius with drill-sergeant energy

categories.name: Screen Capture
categories.description: Per-agent capture configuration. These are set by the agent's profile, not user-editable (yet).

settings.label: Capture Interval
settings.description: Milliseconds between automated screen captures

settings.label: Change Detection Threshold
settings.description: Perceptual hash difference threshold (0=any change, 255=never detect change)

settings.label: Hash Grid Width
settings.description: dHash grid size for change detection (9=coarse 64-bit, 33=fine 1024-bit)

categories.name: Replay Recording
categories.description: Screen recording for replay search. Currently hardcoded.

settings.label: Segment Duration
settings.description: Duration of each replay segment before rotation

settings.label: Max Segments Kept
settings.description: Number of segments kept on disk (rolling buffer)

settings.label: Minimum Free Disk Space
settings.description: Recording stops if free disk space drops below this

categories.name: Audio
categories.description: Audio format is fixed to match provider requirements. Not user-configurable.

categories.name: Team
categories.description: Configure the Gaimer Team — a Claude CLI agent that handles delegated tasks from your voice agent during gameplay.

settings.label: Claude CLI Path
settings.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary. Empty = auto-discover via `which claude` on macOS / `where.exe claude` on Windows. Override if Claude is installed in a non-standard location.

settings.label: Bun Runtime Path
settings.description: Path to the Bun runtime binary. Empty = auto-discover via `which bun`. Required to run the Gaimer channel plugin that bridges tasks to Claude.

settings.label: Auto-Launch Team Session
settings.description: Automatically launch a Claude team session when the app connects to a game. Disable to manage team sessions manually via the Team ConnectorCard.

settings.label: Channel Plugin Directory
settings.description: Path to the Gaimer channel plugin directory. Empty = use the bundled plugin at the default location. Override for development or custom plugin builds.

settings.label: Permission Mode
settings.description: Controls what Claude can do without asking during team sessions. 'default' asks before risky actions, 'acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits, 'auto' auto-approves most actions, 'bypassPermissions' skips all checks, 'plan' is read-only.

categories.name: Developer
categories.description: Debug and development settings. Only visible in debug builds.

settings.label: Use Mock Services
settings.description: Force mock implementations for all AI services (no API calls)

settings.label: Voice Provider Override
settings.description: Force a specific voice provider (overrides all other selection logic)

settings.label: Porcupine Wake Word Key
settings.description: Picovoice access key for hardware wake word detection

storageTypes.env_var: Environment variable (set in shell or .env file)
